correctness.rationale: The exact proof tracks singleton counts S_k, doubleton counts W_k, and previous pitchfork events under uniformly chosen Kingman merges. Marked-leaf factorial moments m_r(k)=(k)_r(k-1)_r/(n-1)_r and the S-W mixed recurrence give explicit f_k,g_k; conditioning on next merge and future marked-pair coalescence yields u_k=2/[3(k-1)] and v_k=1/[(k-1)(k-2)]. These determine Cov(P_n,S_{n,k}) with factor (2k-n), including k=2 separately; independent holding times turn its sum into -1/18 for all n>=5. Direct exact enumeration of all labelled merge sequences n<=7 and a separate rational symbolic finite sum agree; finite enumeration is corroboration, not all-size proof. Small n2,3 zero and n4 +2/9 verified.

originality.rationale: Inspected Janson–Kersting external-length work (singleton lineages, no pitchfork cross moment) and Disanto–Wiehe ranked shape pitchfork enumeration (topological counts without branch lengths). Published cherry–external-length covariance has a different statistic; no marginal theorem implies mixed Cov(P,E) or its stage-dependent sign. Resultary and indexed coalescent-covariance searches did not reveal a stronger equivalent; an undiscovered multistatistic joint generating function remains a residual priority risk.
